start.text: Sera Voss folds her telescope and plants it in the sand. 'Surveyor Renn went into the Glass Flats three days ago. His last signal came from the old observatory, and the lens he carried is worth more than this caravan.'
options: What should I do with the Sun Lens?
I gave the lens to the caravan.

sera_info.text: We haul water, salt and glass along the edge of the Flats. The observatory used to be a landmark, then a ruin, then a warning. Renn thought he could map it safely. The desert disagreed.

sun_offer.text: Renn was carrying the Sun Lens. If the Warden has it, the mirror will burn a path straight through the caravan road. Reach the observatory, break the Warden and bring the lens back.

sun_accept.text: Take the Glass Flats east. Nim knows the safe stones and will go with you. Ilyan can look at anything you find in the ruin.

sun_reminder.text: East across the Flats, then down into the observatory. The Mirror Warden is at the heart of it. Bring the Sun Lens back.

sun_turnin.text: Sera turns the Sun Lens toward the sky and watches the light bend through it. 'Renn would have called this a fair trade.' She pays you from the caravan strongbox.

sun_done.text: The caravan road is open again. Sera has set the Sun Lens on a pole above the camp, and the evening light falls clean and harmless across the sand.

lens_choice.text: Sera holds the Sun Lens between two fingers. 'This is worth more than the whole caravan. I will not pretend otherwise. What will you do with it?'

lens_given.text: Sera wraps the lens in oilcloth and locks it in the strongbox. 'The road remembers who kept it open.' The caravan's drivers will speak well of you.

lens_kept.text: Sera studies you for a long moment, then nods. 'A lens is a tool. I hope it serves you better than it served Renn.' Some of the drivers will remember the choice.

lens_given_done.text: The Sun Lens sits in the caravan strongbox, and Sera has already found a buyer who will keep it out of the wrong hands.

lens_kept_done.text: Sera does not ask about the Sun Lens again. The drivers still nod when you pass, but the welcome is a little cooler.

shard_offer.text: There is a prism shard in the observatory, the size of a fist and clear as winter. Bring it to me and the caravan eats through the next season.

shard_accept.text: Ilyan says the surveyor's chest sits near the observatory altar. The shard should be with his notes.

shard_reminder.text: The prism shard is still in the observatory. The caravan cannot wait forever.

shard_turnin.text: Sera weighs the shard in one hand, then locks it in the strongbox. 'A fair price for a hard road.' She counts out your share.

start.text: Ilyan holds a half-finished lens up to the light. 'Renn's field notes would tell me how the observatory focuses the sun. Without them, I am guessing at the shape of the glass.'
options: I will look for the notes.

ilyan_info.text: A lens is only glass until someone gives it a purpose. The old surveyors ground theirs to read the heat above the Flats. I am trying to remember the trick.

notes_offer.text: Renn kept his notes in a surveyor's chest near the observatory altar. Bring them back and I can finish the lens before the next storm.

notes_accept.text: The observatory is east across the Flats. Sera's scout knows the way. Look for the chest near the altar.

notes_reminder.text: The notes are still in the ruin. I need Renn's measurements.

notes_turnin.text: Ilyan reads the notes twice, then sets them down carefully. 'He was close. Very close.' He gives you a glass talisman from the bench.

notes_done.text: Ilyan's new lens sits in a velvet cradle, and the notes are bound in oilcloth beside it.

start.text: Nim keeps her eyes on the horizon. 'The Flats look empty. They are not. Follow the dark stones and do not step where the sand shines.'

nim_info.text: Glass stalks, shard raiders, and the shimmer when the sun comes down too hard. The ruins are worse. The Warden sings to the mirrors, and the mirrors answer.
